scope: CPU-only full-population headroom falsification; no novelty or performance promotion

workload.metric: inclusive L2 range, unexpanded ordered squared differences

numerics.primary: IEEE ordered FP64 subtraction, separate product, sequential sum, round-to-nearest; no FMA or reassociation
numerics.safe_reject: strict partial>threshold; equality remains unresolved/inclusive hit
numerics.required_dims: first strict crossing k in1..D; hits and last-coordinate nonhits bothD, distinguished separately
numerics.reference: all32 complete preexisting ordered-FP64 arrays; every full960 score must match all8 bytes
numerics.quality: 0 false rejection,0 bit mismatch; first-crossing predecessor<=threshold and crossing>threshold for every reject

estimators.population: all32 million (query,object occurrence) pairs; no sampling CI
estimators.global_mean: sum of integer dimensions /32M, not median of queries
estimators.quantiles: linear interpolation of sorted population, rank=(n-1)*p; equivalent to numpy.percentile(method=linear)
estimators.query_robustness: min/p10/median/p90/max across the original32 query-level means
estimators.bytes: 4*required_dims coordinate payload; decimal GB. No query/state/control/sector/cache/output bytes; not measured traffic or speedup
estimators.CDF: P(required_dims<=K); atD all objects resolved by full evaluation, including hits
estimators.rejection_curve: P(nonhit AND required_dims<=K); atD equals nonhit fraction, not100%
estimators.checkpoint_unresolved: not safely rejected; includes hits at allK; true_hit_fraction uses all objects denominator

margin.definition: ordered full squared L2 minus exact threshold; nonhits only

gates.uncovered: human clarified before measurement: UNCLASSIFIED,stop,no relaxed threshold,no GPU
gates.quality_failure: unvalidated and stop; not a mechanistic NO-GO

execution.prequalification: CPU fixtures plus all32 queries over first4096 objects, not a measurement substitute
execution.primary: sequential original32 queries, all1M objects each; compute all960 for proof while recording counterfactual first crossing

stop: first numerical/input/provenance failure; retain failure and completed records; no automatic replacement

next.GO: Design-only stage accounting128/256/512/960 and prior-art/cost gates; GPU implementation is a separate future campaign
next.CONDITIONAL: Future separately frozen deterministic-order diagnosis only; no GPU now
next.NO_GO: Stop progressive-coordinate original-order route on this frozen workload; no universal representation impossibility
next.UNCLASSIFIED: Stop pending decision; no GPU or ordering now

publication: owned source, scalar histograms,hash manifests,figures only; data/full scores/per-pair dimensions/placement/build logs stay private; no manuscript changes
